description: Java class `LoanOverrideFieldsStepDef` defines step definitions for Cucumber tests related to loan override fields in the Fineract project. It contains methods to verify loan details and to create new loans with override data, interacting with the Fineract API.

classes.name: LoanOverrideFieldsStepDef
classes.description: Step Definitions class for handling loan override field verification and creation in Cucumber tests.

methods.name: checkLoanDetailsFieldWithValue
methods.description: Verifies that a specific loan detail field has the expected value.

methods.name: verifyFieldValue
methods.description: Checks if a loan detail field matches the expected integer value.

methods.name: getIntFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value of a specific override field from loan details.

methods.name: createLoanWithOverrideData
methods.description: Creates a new loan with override data provided via Cucumber DataTable.

methods.name: applyOverrideField
methods.description: Sets override fields on the loan request based on provided field name and value.
